stem: Which quotation from the story “The List” supports the conclusion that Mia and Amit’s social group participates in the competitions between them?

options.label: A
options.text: In the years since that fateful first battle, Mia and Amit had become fast friends (paragraph 5)

options.label: B
options.text: they both had found jobs and didn’t think they would have the time (paragraph 5)

options.label: C
options.text: The unique skills on The List had been devised by their friends (paragraph 6)

options.label: D
options.text: Now, with school only a week away, Mia was left with just one skill (paragraph 6)
